blocks.text: Bohat se amraz (disorders) nizam-e-tanaffus par asar dal kar tanaffus mein rukawat ban sakte hain, aam zukam jaisi halki aur khud theek hone wali kaifiyat se le kar sinusitis, otitis media, pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, emphysema aur COPD jaisi zyada shadeed beemariyon tak.
Oopri tanaffusi raste ke infections
Upper respiratory tract infections (URIs) naak, gale, sinuses aur larynx par asar dalte hain aur tanaffusi qatron (droplets) se ek shakhs se doosre tak asani se muntaqil ho sakte hain.
Sinusitis

Sinusitis sinuses ki andarooni tah ki soozish (inflammation) hai, yani nasal cavity ko gherne wale chaar jore hawa-bhare khale: aankhon ke neeche, aankhon ke oopar, aankhon ke darmiyan aur aankhon ke peeche. Yeh acute ho sakti hai, 7 se 10 din, ya chronic, 12 hafton se zyada. Zyada tar sooratein viral infections se hain; kuch bacterial hain aur shaz-o-nadir fungal infections shamil hote hain. Alamat mein bukhar, band naak, peep jaisi naak ki rutubat, soonghne ki his ka khona, chehre ka dard, yeh ehsaas ke balgham naak ke peeche se gale mein gir raha hai, aur sar dard jo kabhi jhukne par barh jata hai. Zyada tar sooratein viruses se hain aur antibiotics ke baghair theek ho jati hain; agar infection bacterial ho to aam taur par antibiotics ya sulpha dawaein likhi jati hain, aur doctor sinuses aur naak ki soozish kam karne aur sehatyabi tez karne ke liye nebulisation bhi tajweez kar sakta hai. Chronic ya baar baar hone wali sinusitis mein ilaj mein naak ki surgery shamil ho sakti hai jis mein pathogens aur mucus nikale jate hain.
Otitis media

Otitis media darmiyani kaan (middle ear) ki soozish hai. Yeh acute (tez shuruat) ya chronic (chhe hafton se zyada) ho sakti hai. Aam sabab Eustachian tube mein mayah ka jama hona hai jo middle ear se nikal nahin pata; na nikla mayah middle ear mein bacteria aur viruses ko barhne deta hai. Alamat mein kaan ka shadeed dard, ek ya dono kaan kheenchna, bukhar, kaan se mayah nikalna, tawazun ka khona aur sunne mein mushkil shamil hain. Ilaj mein khane aur lagane wali dard-kush dawaein aur, agar sabab bacterial ho, antibiotics shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: ek khaaka chehra jis par neeli shaklein surkh nasal cavity ki lakeer ke gird aankhon ke oopar, darmiyan, neeche aur peeche sinuses dikhati hain. Daen: ek khaaka kaan jis mein bairooni nali, kaan ka parda, mayah wala gulabi middle ear box, pharynx tak neeche jati sabz Eustachian tube aur neela andarooni kaan.
blocks.caption: Sinuses aur middle ear (Figures 10.10 aur 10.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sinuses nasal cavity ke gird chaar jore hawa-bhare khale hain, aankhon ke neeche, oopar, darmiyan aur peeche; jab un ki tah zyada tar viruses se soozish-zada ho to nateeja sinusitis hai, band naak, rutubat, chehre ke dard aur sar dard ke saath, 7 se 10 din acute ya 12 hafton se aage chronic. Middle ear kaan ke parde ke peeche hai aur Eustachian tube se pharynx mein nikasi karta hai; agar mayah na nikle to us mein bacteria aur viruses barh kar otitis media karte hain, kaan ke dard, bukhar, rutubat, tawazun ke khone aur kam sunne ke saath.

blocks.text: Nichle tanaffusi raste ke infections
Lower respiratory tract infections mein pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, phephre ka phora (lung abscess) aur bronchitis shamil hain.
Pneumonia

Pneumonia acute tanaffusi infection ki ek shakal hai jo halki se jan-lewa beemari tak kar sakti hai. Pneumonia mein ek ya dono phephron ke alveoli soozish-zada aur peep aur mayah se bhare hote hain, jo saans lena dardnak banata aur oxygen lene ko mehdood karta hai. Yeh zyada tar viruses ya bacteria se hoti hai aur duniya bhar mein bachchon ki maut ka sab se bara infectious sabab hai. Kai jandar ise kar sakte hain, bunyadi taur par bacteria (khaas kar Streptococcus pneumoniae) ya viruses (jaise human rhinovirus) aur kam aam taur par fungi. Alamat mein balgham wali khansi, saans ki tangi, seene ka dard, bukhar, jild ka neela-pan, bhook ka khatma, tez dil ki dharkan aur thakan shamil hain. Khaas antibiotics bacterial pneumonia ka ilaj karti hain, analgesics bukhar aur dard kam karti hain, aur vaccination bachchon aur baligon mein kuch bacterial aur viral pneumonias se bachati hai.

blocks.title: Bachchon mein pneumonia
blocks.text: Pneumonia ne 2017 mein paanch saal se kam umr ke 808,000 se zyada bachchon ko maara, jo paanch saal se kam umr ke bachchon ki tamam amwat ka 15% tha.
Pulmonary tuberculosis (phephron ki TB)

Tuberculosis (TB) bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis se hone wala chronic infection hai. Yeh jism ke bohat se hisson par asar dal sakta hai magar aam taur par phephron par; phephron ki tuberculosis pulmonary tuberculosis hai. Yeh bohat zyada mutaddi (contagious) hai aur khansi ya chheenk se phailti hai. Bacteria phephron mein dakhil ho kar barhte hain, aur alveoli samet phephre ke tissue mein soozish aur nuqsan karte hain; nuqsan phephre ke tissue mein chhote khale ya surakh (cavities) bana sakta hai, jo phephron ka theek kaam karna mushkil banate hain. Barhi hui sooraton mein alveoli itne kharab hote hain ke phephre jism ko kafi oxygen dene ke qabil nahin rehte, jo respiratory failure, ek tibbi hangami soorat, tak le jata hai. Bari alamat khoon wali khansi, waqfe waqfe se bukhar aam taur par shaam ko, raat ka paseena, wazan ki kami, bhook ka khatma (anorexia), udaasi (depression), kamzori aur khushk khansi, aur phephron ki pleura ki soozish se seene ka dard hain. Ilaj mein kai antibiotics ka mahinon ke tawil arse tak ba-qaidgi se istemal hai.
Phephron ke amraz
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)

COPD phephron ki chronic soozishi beemari hai. Is ke aam asbab tambaku noshi (smoking) aur nuqsan-deh aaloodgi (pollutants) aur kimiyai dhuen ka tawil samna hain; jeneti rujhan (protein alpha-1 antitrypsin ki kami) wale thore se log smoking ya aaloodgi ke numayan samne ke baghair bhi COPD ka shikar ho sakte hain. Alamat musalsal balgham (sputum) wali khansi, saans ki tangi, seeti jaisi saans (wheezing), seene ki jakran, thakan aur baar baar tanaffusi infections hain. COPD la-ilaj hai, magar dhuen, aaloodgi aur kimiyai maddon ka samna kam karne se is ka barhna sust hota hai; doosre ilaj bronchodilators, saans se li jane wali corticosteroids, pulmonary rehabilitation aur oxygen therapy hain, aur kuch shadeed sooraton mein phephre ki paiwand-kari (lung transplantation) jaisi surgery par ghaur ho sakta hai.
Emphysema

Emphysema COPD ki ek qism hai jis mein alveoli ki andarooni deewarein kharab ho kar aakhir phat jati hain, jo bohat se chhote khalon ke bajaye ek bara hawa ka khala banata aur gas ke tabadle ke liye dastiyab satahi raqba kam karta hai. Is ka bunyadi sabab smoking hai; yeh hawa ki aaloodgi, gard ya kimiyai dhuen ke tawil samne se, ya protein alpha-1 antitrypsin ki jeneti kami se bhi ho sakta hai. Alamat saans ki tangi, khansi, wheezing, thakan aur seene ki jakran hain. Smoking chhorna is ke intizam ka sab se aham qadam hai, kyunke smoking jari rehne se beemari tez barhti hai; doosre ilaj bronchodilators, saans se li jane wali steroids, oxygen therapy aur pulmonary rehabilitation hain.

blocks.title: Chronic bronchitis
blocks.text: Chronic bronchitis COPD ki ek aur qism hai, jis mein bronchial naliyon ki soozish aur tangi aur mucus ki barhi hui paidawar hai jo raston ko mazeed band kar ke saans mushkil banati hai; yeh teen mahine se do saal tak rehti hai. Yeh cigarette ke dhuen, hawa ki aaloodgi ya sanati gard jaise khush-khush karne wale maddon (irritants) ke tawil samne se hoti hai, aur is ki alamat taqreeban COPD jaisi hain: wheezing, saans ki tangi, seene ki jakran aur baar baar tanaffusi infections. Is ka intizam smoking chhorne, bronchodilators, pulmonary rehabilitation aur kuch sooraton mein oxygen therapy se hota hai.

blocks.alt: Alveoli ke chaar panels. Sehatmand: khule cream thaile surkh capillary ke saath. Pneumonia: khakistari peep aur mayah se bhare thaile. Tuberculosis: kale phate khalon wale thaile. Emphysema: ek bara mila hua thaila jis mein dashed lakeerein dikhati hain ke deewarein kahan tooti hain. Neeche ek box COPD ka khulasa deta hai.
blocks.caption: Pneumonia, tuberculosis aur emphysema alveoli ke saath kya karte hain (Figures 10.12 se 10.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sehatmand alveoli patle, khule aur hawa-bhare hain. Pneumonia mein yeh soozish-zada aur peep aur mayah se bhare hote hain, to saans mein dard hota aur kam oxygen li jati hai; Streptococcus pneumoniae jaise bacteria, rhinovirus jaise viruses aur shaz-o-nadir fungi asbab hain, antibiotics, analgesics se ilaj aur vaccines se bachao. Pulmonary tuberculosis mein Mycobacterium tuberculosis barhta, tissue kharab karta aur khale chhorta hai, mahinon tak kai antibiotics se ilaj. Emphysema mein, zyada tar smoking se hone wali COPD, andarooni deewarein toot kar ek bara khala banati hain jis mein tabadle ki satah kam hai; smoking chhorna, bronchodilators, saans wali steroids, oxygen aur rehabilitation madad karte hain.

blocks.explanation: Pehle ko pneumonia hai: soozish-zada alveoli mein peep aur mayah hawa aur capillaries ke darmiyan moti rukawat dalte aur alveoli ki hawa rakhne ki gunjaish kam karte hain, to kam oxygen diffuse hoti hai. Doosre ko emphysema hai, ek COPD: jab bohat se chhote alveoli mil kar ek bara khala banate hain to diffusion ke liye kul satahi raqba gir jata hai, to hawa pohnchne ke bawajood kahin kam oxygen khoon mein ja pati hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Oopri raste ke infections qatron se phailte hain: sinusitis (aankhon ke neeche, oopar, darmiyan aur peeche sinuses ki soozish; zyada tar viral) aur otitis media (Eustachian tube ke na nikle mayah se middle ear ki soozish).

Nichle raste ke infections: pneumonia (peep aur mayah se bhare alveoli; bacteria, viruses, shaz-o-nadir fungi; bachchon ka sab se bara infectious qatil) aur pulmonary tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis, mutaddi, phephre mein khale, mahinon ki antibiotics).

COPD smoking, aaloodgi ya alpha-1 antitrypsin ki kami se phephron ki chronic soozish hai, la-ilaj magar dhuen se bachne se sust; emphysema (phati alveolar deewarein) aur chronic bronchitis (tang, mucus-bhari bronchial naliyan) is ki qismein hain.
